note: Central product/linguistic decision register. AI drafts do NOT resolve these. No APPROVED invented. 4E.6 added hr/bg/uk. Slovenian (sl) BLOCKED — not in APP_LANGUAGES and no message pack; do not invent.

decisions.title: Portuguese regional variant (pt vs pt-PT vs pt-BR)
decisions.currentBehavior: UI locale code is `pt` only. Quasar maps pt→pt-BR. Machine drafts use international Portuguese (você) with PT/BR lexical mix (e.g. Utilizador vs senha/Salvar).

alternatives.label: pt-BR — Brazilian Portuguese
cons: Would require lexical cleanup of PT-PT forms

impact.preferred_locale: Stay `pt` or migrate to `pt-BR` (requires APP_LANGUAGES + DB migration)
impact.uiOptions: Would change 59-language list if introducing pt-BR

alternatives.label: pt-PT — European Portuguese
cons: Quasar has no first-class pt-PT pack (would use pt or custom)
Conflicts with current Quasar pt-BR mapping

impact.quasar: Need alternate pack or accept pt-BR chrome mismatch

alternatives.label: pt — single code with documented working norm
cons: Lexical mix remains until human regional pass

impact.translations: Human review enforces chosen norm under `pt`

decisions.recommendation: Prefer VARIANT C short-term (stabilize under `pt`, human regional pass). Defer introducing pt-PT/pt-BR locale codes until product explicitly wants split markets.
decisions.risk: Shipping mixed PT/BR copy without decision confuses users and reviewers.

decisions.title: Donor / Donee product role labels
decisions.currentBehavior: English role terms kept in MACHINE_DRAFT catalogs (aligned DE/FR/ES/PL/IT/PT/CS/HU/NL/RO).
decisions.recommendation: Keep English until global UX terminology workshop; do not localize piecemeal.
decisions.risk: Inconsistent role names across languages damage product clarity.

decisions.title: Contribution vs Donation vs Token top-up wording
decisions.currentBehavior: Help act ≈ Contribution/Wsparcie/Contributo/Příspěvek pomoci/Hozzájárulás/Bijdrage/Contribuție; wallet recharge ≈ Recarga/Ricarica/Auffüllung/Dobití/Feltöltés/Steun/Sprijin — charity 'donation' avoided where context is tokens.
alternatives: Keep Donation only for charity contexts
decisions.recommendation: Human linguistic review per language; preserve product meaning (help ≠ charity-only).
decisions.risk: Users may think dreamhubb is only financial fundraising.

decisions.title: Post terminology (Publication / Wpis / Beitrag / …)
decisions.currentBehavior: FE uses localized content-unit terms (Publication, Wpis, Beitrag, Publicación, Pubblicazione, Publicação, Příspěvek, Bejegyzés, Bericht, Postare).
decisions.recommendation: Keep localized forms; confirm in human review.
decisions.risk: Low if consistent within each locale.

decisions.title: Feed label (loanword vs localized)
decisions.currentBehavior: Often kept as Feed; FR Fil; CS Nástěnka; HU Hírfolyam; NL Tijdlijn; RO Flux — alternatives in glossaries.
alternatives: Localize (Fil, Tablica, Bacheca, Nástěnka, Hírfolyam, Tijdlijn, Flux, …)

decisions.title: Token product term
decisions.currentBehavior: Token kept as product term (not ficha/jeton/moneda).
decisions.recommendation: Keep Token unless product rebrands economy.
